_help.about: Which way of life a camp or ruin lives (design 30 Sept §BO). site_rules are tried in order at the site; the first that matches wins; 'by_biome' falls through to the table. null = no camps here. The biome then DRESSES the life (each people file's dressing.by_biome).
_help.site_rules: when: a plain-language test for the site placer; people: a data/peoples id.
_help.canopy: Design 30 Sept §BT: the tree-dwellers. Their whole village is up in the giants — platforms, vine bridges, rope ladders — and they never come down; the player climbs to reach them (the tree-climb system, §AU).

site_rules.when: an overhang, a cliff foot with a recess, or a cave mouth at the site
geology rock == karst and a cave or sinkhole within 200 m

an old-growth stand with three or more giant trees (stand.json giant) within 60 m of the site, in TEMPERATE_RAINFOREST, TROPICAL_RAINFOREST, JUNGLE, CLOUD_FOREST or TEMPERATE_DECIDUOUS; rare (about one such site in six)
a lake or lagoon shore within 200 m (not the sea)
biome in SWAMP, BOG, FEN, FRESHWATER_MARSH, WET_MEADOW, or wetland within 200 m
a river reach of order 2 or more within 200 m
